text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, as we're walking through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Here… th-this is for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a piece of paper from Rice Shower's trembling hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara told me about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There's a New Year's raffle in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The special prize is supposed to be something really incredible! So… um…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I got you a ticket. I want you to give it a try.
choice_data_list: Why don't we do it together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way! If I'm involved, there's no way we'll w—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We've got some takers! Step on up and give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you really want to do it… together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Praying for good luck, we grasp the raffle spinner's handle together and turn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the spinner's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! You did it, you did it! Congrats, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! You did it, you did it! Congrats, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but you're the one who won, not me.
choice_data_list: We pulled the spinner together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The grand-prize is just as much hers as it is mine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Is it really okay for me to take it too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm… in that case… d-does…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean… we'll go to the hot spring together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Since we both won… I'd like to go with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that okay?
choice_data_list: If that's what you want, then of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Well then, once we've done everything we want to do and need a break, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Well then, once we've done everything we want to do and need a break, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Rice Shower and I promise to use the hot spring vacation ticket together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-first-prize?! I can't believe it!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you pulling the spinner with me!

text_block_list.text: All right, you two! Here's your prize!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whoa… It looks delicious. My mouth is already wateri—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrooowl…

text_block_list.text: Agh! Not now, tummy! Everyone's watching!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, let's!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like she's worked up an appetite to match the surprise and happiness she got from playing the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enjoy the delicious deluxe carrot hamburger steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow… there are so many!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look at all these carrots!

text_block_list.text: …Oh! You're right. I don't know if my tummy has room for this many.

text_block_list.text: Um, let's think… Hmm…

text_block_list.text: A few days later, I enjoy some homemade carrot cookies with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.text: We didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I can't believe it. I thought my bad luck would bring us absolutely nothing, like always…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It may be third-prize, but a win is a win. Rice Shower keeps the carrot as a memento of our day together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Of course I lost. I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Still, thanks for trying with me!
